book_sam: Previous notes assumed nightstand_b1 for late evening, but day 6 20:16 feedback showed it at armchair_l1. Sam reads in the living room in the early evening. Check armchair_l1 for queries between 19:00 and 21:00. Do not assume it moves to the bedroom immediately after dinner.

charger_sam: Previous notes prioritized nightstand_b1, but day 6 21:16 feedback showed it at desk_b1, while day 6 22:50 feedback showed it back at nightstand_b1. The charger moves from desk_b1 to nightstand_b1 late at night (after 22:00). Check desk_b1 for queries between 20:00 and 22:00, and nightstand_b1 for queries after 22:00. The item is not static at the nightstand throughout the evening.

mug_sam: Previous notes prioritized coffee_table_l1 for evenings, but day 6 21:23 feedback showed it at desk_b1. The mug moves to the bedroom desk in the late evening, not staying in the living room. Check desk_b1 for queries after 20:00. Do not assume it remains at the coffee table or kitchen table during late evening hours.

General Observation: Items do not stay in their "resting" spots (living room/dining) throughout the evening. Sam’s personal items (book, mug, charger) move to bedroom spots (armchair, desk, nightstand) as the evening progresses. Prioritize time-of-day specific locations: living room for early evening (19:00-21:00), bedroom desk for late evening (20:00-22:00), and bedroom nightstand for very late night (after 22:00). Do not assume static locations across the entire evening.
